title: S3 KMS-Encrypted Object AccessDenied
symptom: User has full S3 permissions but receives AccessDenied specifically when downloading encrypted S3 objects.
initial_observations: s3:GetObject fails with AccessDenied on objects encrypted with customer-managed KMS key (SSE-KMS).
environment: S3 bucket with SSE-KMS encryption enabled.

possible_causes.cause: Caller lacks kms:Decrypt permission on the AWS KMS key used to encrypt the S3 object
possible_causes.evidence_needed: KMS Key Policy does not authorize the caller's IAM principal for kms:Decrypt.
possible_causes.remediation: Update the KMS Key Policy to allow caller's principal `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey`.

investigation_steps.title: Check Object Encryption Metadata
investigation_steps.explanation: Identify the KMS key ARN (SSEKMSKeyId) used to encrypt the object.

investigation_steps.title: Inspect KMS Key Policy
investigation_steps.command: aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <key-arn> --policy-name default --output text | jq .
investigation_steps.explanation: Check if KMS key policy grants access to caller principal.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: Missing principal in KMS policy statement.

verification: aws s3 cp s3://my-bucket/file.txt . downloads successfully.
prevention: Include IAM roles in KMS key policy when configuring bucket default encryption with CMKs.
